name: Bounded Forward Scattering Propagator (Dipole Model)
definition: A propagator $G_{bf}$ for bounded volumes that approximately satisfies absorbing boundary conditions (Eq. 3) by using a dipole setup based on the infinite volume propagator $G_f$. It uses a modified normal and a virtual source.
summary: The Bounded Forward Scattering Propagator handles finite volumes by using a dipole method with a virtual source to enforce absorbing boundary conditions, distinguishing itself from empirical corrections.
